title: Padding the initial configuration
statement: Let $k,K$ be natural numbers, let $S,H$ be types, let $	ext{emb}:S\to H$ be a map, let $q:S$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. Padding the initial configuration with state $q$ on input $x$ gives the seam configuration on the $K$-tape bank with state $	ext{emb}(q)$ and empty words on all tapes.
hypotheses_covered: map emb from S to H
